body: Ang pinaka-interesting dito for me is hindi 'may bagong robot' kundi may layers na: public funding, data/model work, regional adoption, compute/platform partners, then factory-domain collaboration. Pero gusto kong makita ang first boring-but-beautiful proof: same learned process working on a second machine or second factory with less re-engineering. Kapag nangyari iyon, ibang level na iyon from clever demo. Transferability ang tunay na magic trick—hindi yung robot na marunong mag-wave sa expo.
